command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
. /etc/os-release
printf 'os=%s version=%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
command -v openssl
command -v update-ca-certificates
sudo -n true
if [ -e /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt ] || [ -e /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key ]; then printf 'existing_ca_artifacts=yes\n'; else printf 'existing_ca_artifacts=no\n'; fi

set -eu

set -eu
umask 077
workdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$workdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always' -keyout "$workdir/root.key" -out "$workdir/root.crt" 2>/dev/null
sudo install -o root -g root -m 600 "$workdir/root.key" /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo install -o root -g root -m 644 "$workdir/root.crt" /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
printf 'installed_key_and_certificate\n'

command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running --wait
sudo test "$(stat -c '%U:%G:%a' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key)" = 'root:root:600'
test "$(stat -c '%U:%G:%a' /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt)" = 'root:root:644'
printf 'key_permissions=%s\n' "$(sudo stat -c '%U:%G:%a' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key)"
printf 'cert_permissions=%s\n' "$(stat -c '%U:%G:%a' /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt)"
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
key_pub=$(sudo openssl pkey -in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
test "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub"
printf 'key_certificate_match=yes sha256=%s\n' "$cert_pub"
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+4p'
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
trust_link=$(find /etc/ssl/certs -maxdepth 1 -type l -lname '*os-comparison-root-ca.pem' -print -quit)
test -n "$trust_link"
printf 'trust_symlink=%s target=%s\n' "$trust_link" "$(readlink "$trust_link")"
